title: Add golden test prompt files for blunder annotator
description:
We have golden test prompt files that capture what the pilot LLM sees at each decision point (puppeteer/tests/golden/prompts/). We should have the equivalent for the blunder annotator — capturing the exact prompt sent to Opus for each decision evaluation.

This would:
- Surface changes to blunder prompt assembly (format, context, card references) in PR diffs
- Catch regressions like the subsequent_actions leak or broken snapshot context
- Make it easy to review what the annotator actually sees for a given decision

Approach: pick a representative game (e.g. game_20260216_074122_g2), run the annotator's _format_decisions + prompt assembly on a few interesting decisions, and snapshot the full prompt as golden files. Compare in CI like the pilot golden prompts.

Unlike pilot golden prompts, these don't need a live XMage server — they can run purely from exported .json.gz files, so they'd be fast unit tests.
